title: How to Breed 18 More Palworld Pals | 3 Easy Combos Each | Palworld Breeding Guide
description: Eighteen more Palworld Pals with three verified breeding combos each, fifty four combos in total, checked against PalBreedCalc and the Palworld 1.0 breeding formula.

sections.heading: Eighteen more Pals, three combos each
sections.script: Welcome back to HarryBeast Gaming. Today we have another big Palworld breeding guide: eighteen more Pals, and for every one of them, three different breeding combos. Why three? Because the Pal you want might need a parent you have not caught yet, and with three options you can almost always use Pals that are already in your Palbox. Every combo in this video was checked against the PalBreedCalc breeding list and the Palworld one point zero breeding formula, so these are real pairs, not guesses. The basics are simple. Build a Breeding Farm at your base, assign one male and one female parent to it, and keep Cake in the farm's box, because without Cake there are no eggs. Collect the egg, put it in an Egg Incubator, and wait for it to hatch. Grab a pen, or save this video, and let's go.

sections.heading: Tanzee and Hoocrates
sections.script: First up: Tanzee. Combo one: Cattiva plus Mau. Combo two: Celaray plus Vixy. Combo three: Chikipi plus Melpaca. All three pairs hatch the same Pal, so use whichever parents you already own. Put the pair on your Breeding Farm, add a cake, and when the egg hatches in your incubator you get a brand new Tanzee. Next: Hoocrates. Combo one: Chikipi plus Mozzarina. Combo two: Clovee plus Daedream. Combo three: Cremis plus Foxparks. All three pairs hatch the same Pal, so use whichever parents you already own. Put the pair on your Breeding Farm, add a cake, and when the egg hatches in your incubator you get a brand new Hoocrates.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.script: That is eighteen Pals and fifty four combos. Let us end with a joke. In Palworld, you can build a perfect breeding farm and still spend the whole evening wondering why your Pals are sleeping instead of working. Now it is your turn. Which of these Pals are you going to breed first, and which one should we cover with five new combos next? Tell us in the comments. If this guide helped you, subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more Palworld breeding guides, and we will see you in the next video.
